overview: Global political developments saw Trump allies lose ground in recent elections in Brazil and Serbia. Anthropic filed for an IPO featuring extensive risk warnings regarding artificial intelligence, while economic policy veterans highlighted risks in AI overreliance. San Francisco experienced local election developments alongside police arrests for a Tenderloin hit-and-run and an abandoned vehicle in a Muni tunnel. Meanwhile, Hawaii faces a looming heavy rain flood watch, dropping resident support for tourism, and reports on federal regulations crippling local farmers.

items.title: Trump allies fall in two elections as Netanyahu faces next test
items.summary: Trump allies took a double blow as Brazil rejected a Bolsonaro comeback and Serbia toppled a ruling party.

items.title: Economic policy vets see risks in AI overreliance
items.summary: Economic policy experts warned about the potential risks of relying too heavily on artificial intelligence tools.

items.title: Anthropic's IPO outlines AI's extraordinary risks
items.summary: Anthropic's IPO filing includes an extensive list of extreme risk warnings regarding the potential dangers of its technology.

items.title: Orwellian arguments, fuzzy math and a hippie cult: This is the dawning of the S.F. midterm election
items.summary: The dawning of the San Francisco midterm election features debate over Mayor Lurie's arguments and math.

items.title: S.F. police arrest woman for fatal Tenderloin hit-and-run
items.summary: San Francisco police arrested a woman on Treasure Island in connection with a fatal Tenderloin hit-and-run.

items.title: Driver abandoned vehicle inside Muni tunnel in ‘hit and run,’ S.F. police say
items.summary: San Francisco police reported that a driver abandoned a damaged vehicle inside a Muni tunnel after a hit-and-run.

items.title: Looming heavy rain prompts flood watch for Hawaii
items.summary: All Hawaiian islands are under a statewide flood watch due to a slow-moving weather system bringing heavy rain and tropical moisture.

items.title: Hawaii resident support for tourism falls near record low
items.summary: Hawaii resident support for tourism has fallen near a record low amid growing concerns over visitor disrespect.

items.title: Federal Regulations Are Crippling Hawaiʻi Farmers, Report Says
items.summary: A new report states that burdensome federal biosecurity processes are crippling Hawaii farmers and limiting the agricultural industry.
